subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Which open Google Chat media-upload fallback PR should be the canonical landing path after conflict refresh?
rationale: The same canonical issue has multiple open conflicting PR candidates, and this member-authored PR needs a maintainer choice plus a small metadata preservation repair before merge.

options.title: Refresh This Candidate
options.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, preserve action send metadata in the fallback branch, and keep the three runtime paths covered by tests before final merge review.

options.title: Choose A Sibling PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer another open implementation that is refreshed, proof-accepted, and covers message actions, outbound adapter delivery, and monitor reply delivery.

options.title: Close Duplicates After Selection
options.body: Once one implementation is chosen, close or supersede the remaining overlapping fallback PRs with a link to the canonical path.

recommendation.title: Refresh This Candidate
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, preserve action send metadata in the fallback branch, and keep the three runtime paths covered by tests before final merge review.
